qa_pairs.question: What is the amperage rating of Fuse 20 in the power distribution box?
What wire gauge is used for the connection from Fuse 20 to the hot water cut off switch?
qa_pairs.answer: The wire gauge is 4 GN/BR (4 gauge Green/Brown).

qa_pairs.question: What happens to the hot water cut off switch when the rotary temperature control knob is rotated by more than 90 degrees from its leftmost position?
qa_pairs.answer: The switch is opened when the rotary temperature control knob is rotated by more than 90 degrees from its leftmost position.

qa_pairs.question: What is the amperage rating of the A/C in-line fuse?
qa_pairs.answer: The A/C in-line fuse is rated at 3 AMP.

qa_pairs.question: What wire connects to ground distribution at connection S229?
qa_pairs.answer: Wire S229 with a 2.5 BR (2.5 gauge Brown) connects to ground distribution.

qa_pairs.question: What special note is provided about some vehicles regarding additional components?
qa_pairs.answer: Some vehicles may contain an additional splice (see ground distribution).

qa_pairs.question: When does the hot water system run according to the diagram?
qa_pairs.answer: The hot water system runs only from unloader relay K7.

qa_pairs.question: What is the function of the water shut off solenoid shown in the diagram?
qa_pairs.answer: The water shut off solenoid shuts water off to heater core when energized.
